product_outcome: The formal WinUI shell exposes an accessible physical-device refresh action next to the output picker.
Refresh is connection-aware, reports progress and outcome through status text, and asks the engine for one bounded device-catalog snapshot.
Timeouts, failures and stale snapshots fail closed; the previous picker remains usable without fabricated devices.
